modifications.prefabs: Removed vendor MonoBehaviour and Light components and their GameObject component entries; original particle systems, renderer vertex streams, meshes, colors and materials retained.
modifications.shaders: Resolved publisher cfxrshader conditional branches into ordinary .shader files; original GUIDs retained and material shader fileIDs remapped to 4800000; CustomEditor and two vendor-only Inspector drawer decorators removed; publisher Cg includes and serialized keywords retained.
modifications.runtime: Project presenter owns bounded pooling, clock, stop/clear and placement. No vendor executable or demo scripts imported.
modifications.urpAdapter: Publisher URP branches regenerated without touching upgraded meshes/materials/prefabs; explicit UniversalPipeline tag and corrected CFXR_URP spelling in optional passes.

importValidation: Curated source only; Unity shader compilation, native visual inspection and WebGL validation required by build owner.
